annotations.title: Is M&A in this sector rising or falling, and who is doing it?

description: Use when the user asks about M&A activity, deal flow or consolidation in a sector, whether now is a good time to buy or sell a company in it, or who the active acquirers are. Returns, quarter by quarter, the 8-K merger-agreement documents that mention the sector as a share of all 8-K merger agreements, from SEC EDGAR full-text search, whether that share is rising or falling, an industry-code cross-check, and the most active filers with their latest filing linked. It counts documents, not deals, and gives no deal values or multiples. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For one company's write-downs of what it bought, use run_write_downs. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/deal-activity.json

sic.description: Optional, with phrase: four-digit SIC codes for the cross-check, comma-separated, e.g. "7372,7373".
